items.author: 洪灏
items.text: 韓股重挫 博通CEO：AI融資比晶片短缺危險
items.summary_cn: 据报道，在韩股重挫之际，博通CEO认为AI融资风险比芯片短缺更危险，对AI资本开支循环提出警示。

items.author: 洪灏
items.text: 兩導火線引爆晶片股拋售 美早盤美光、SK海力士未止跌
items.summary_cn: 据报道，两项利空引爆芯片股抛售，美光与SK海力士早盘继续下跌，显示市场正在下调存储芯片板块短期预期。

items.author: Pelosi
items.text: Trump and Nancy Pelosi’s Top AI Stock Pick: NVIDIA (NVDA)
items.summary_cn: 报道将特朗普和Nancy Pelosi列为英伟达的热门AI股票支持者，但该条未提供Pelosi最新交易披露。

items.author: 段永平
items.text: 恒生指數倒升74點 滙控升逾1% 聯想逆市跌近4%
items.summary_cn: 据报道，恒指升74点期间汇控涨逾1%、联想跌近4%，直接反映银行股与科技硬件股分化。

items.text: Do you believe it can fly? Tesla Roadster to make debut
items.summary_cn: 马斯克谈及特斯拉Roadster即将亮相，未提供明确投资判断，但可能成为特斯拉新品宣传事件。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Tesla's Elon Musk Might Have Gone Back on His Word, but It's Working in China
items.summary_cn: 据报道，马斯克此前对中国市场的表态出现变化，但特斯拉在中国业务层面仍在奏效，未披露新的明确买卖动作。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Musk says US military controls Starlink’s limits after Ukraine outcry
items.summary_cn: 据报道，在乌克兰方面抗议后，美国军方开始掌控SpaceX星链系统的使用限制，显示卫星通信服务受政府及地缘政治约束加深。

items.text: Michael Burry Says Stocks Could Peak Within 9 Months — and He’s Betting Against the Nasdaq and Chip Stocks

items.author: Trump
items.text: I was just in Alaska launching the largest Energy Infrastructure Project in Alaska History— The Alaska LNG Project. This 50 Billion Dollar Infrastructure Investment from The Republic of Korea is part of their Trade and Investment Deal with me. I am also announcing today that my Commerce Secretary, Howard Lutnick, has secured an Offtake Commitment from Taiwan of between 70 to 80 Billion Dollars for Alaska LNG — That is 30% of the Pipeline for the next 20 years. This is the largest Offtake Agreement in History. On top of that, Taiwan has also agreed to Invest 4.4 Billion Dollars in Equity into t
items.summary_cn: 特朗普宣布韩国参与500亿美元阿拉斯加LNG项目，并称台湾承诺未来20年采购价值700亿至800亿美元管道气的30%。

items.summary_cn: 特朗普称格陵兰即将启动大规模油气及矿产勘探，暗示加强能源与关键资源开发并强化对欧洲的安全布局。
